bundle.shortDescription: Free Nepali and English typing tutor
bundle.longDescription: Typeshala is a free, open-source typing tutor for English and Nepali, built with Tauri v2 and React. It teaches three layouts from the same set of structured lessons: English QWERTY, Romanized Nepali, and Traditional Preeti, the legacy Nepali key layout that turns familiar QWERTY key positions into Devanagari text. Practice with live words-per-minute and accuracy scoring, virtual keyboard guidance with the next key lit, progress trends, light and dark themes, a bilingual English and Nepali interface, and a bonus Ramayana typing game. Runs natively on Windows, macOS and Linux. Works entirely offline: no account, no subscription, no network calls, and all progress stays on your device.
